style: 128 BPM. Instrumental tech house, melodic techno, 4/4. True four-on-the-floor kick, tight clap and bright offbeat open hi-hat, sidechained analog bass, clean repeating short analog pluck riff. A filtered quiet breakdown and a full return of the original pluck hook, energetic electronic transitions and a clean ending. No vocals, no singing, no choir, no spoken words, no vocal samples. Oscillator-only synthesizers and electronic drums.
